decision: Final V5 preserves visible hand/relic action and replaces excessive tiny rim geometry with four bevel quads. Cross final reload CPU16.86/16.48→18.38/18.02ms, FPS48.09/49.55→45.54/45.97; p95 frame about36ms both. Earlier heavier V3/V4 rejected. Shotgun V4 geometry unchanged inV5; its measured improvement is not a new finalV5 retest.
